title: Rampart coverage ledger
description: projects/<slug>/coverage.json: which units (repo directories that hold at least one hunt-worthy file, host probes) each run covered, and with which pack versions. An L3 unit skipped as unchanged keeps the entry of the run that covered it. Keys of `units` are <system>|<layer>|<unitId>; every value must match $defs.unitEntry (the store checks each entry, because the validator has no per-key schema).

classes.description: Optional: the pack class ids hunted on this unit at these pack versions (added by Plan 2's fix wave; an entry without it records no classes).

effort.description: Optional: the effort of the run that stamped this entry.

engine.description: Optional (0.5.0): the hunt engine version (hunt-plan.cjs HUNT_ENGINE) of the run that stamped this entry. An L3 unit is skipped as unchanged only when it matches the current engine.

complete.description: Optional (0.5.0): false when the hunt that covered the unit was incomplete (a capped hunter, invalid candidates, an undecided candidate or a missing vote). Only a complete entry lets a later L3 run skip the unit.
